title: Public directory listing of /config/ exposes database credentials
proof: Anonymous GET http://127.0.0.1:8081/config/ returns directory listing with config.inc.php.bak, config.inc.php.dist, config.inc.php. The .bak file reveals: $_DVWA['db_server']='127.0.0.1'; $_DVWA['db_database']='dvwa'; $_DVWA['db_user']='app'; $_DVWA['db_password']='vulnerables'.
